data.description:
## Context / Problem

`tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_caused_by_autoderive.py:66-130` and `test_caused_by_autoderive_heldout.py:58-125` contain AST-identical regressions with no distinct assertion or boundary. This is HARDENING: it has no demonstrated production defect but duplicates subprocess-heavy CI and future maintenance.

## Approach

Retain the canonical lifecycle regression, delete the AST-identical copy, and parameterize only cases that exercise genuinely distinct behavior. Do not weaken the actual caused-by autoderivation contract.

## Scope

- the canonical and held-out caused-by autoderivation tests
- shared fixtures only if a distinct boundary case is preserved

Cascade flag: true. Recensus parametrization, dynamic test collection, and fixture references before deletion.

## Testing

Run both test modules before the change, then run the retained/parameterized suite and inspect collection to prove exactly one copy of the duplicate behavior remains.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The AST-identical duplicate regression is removed.
- [ ] The canonical lifecycle regression remains and exercises the same autoderivation behavior.
- [ ] Any retained parameterization corresponds to a documented distinct boundary, not the former duplicate.
- [ ] Focused collection/test output proves the duplicate executes once and the lifecycle suite passes.
data.title: Remove the duplicate blame-autoderivation regression
